rows.note: Use 幾個 for a few countable things or people; it is the all-purpose everyday choice.

example.english: I bought several oranges to bring home.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gei2 go3 caang2 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use 幾百萬 when the amount is several million or a few million.

example.english: The company makes several million a year.
example.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 jat1 nin4 zaan6 gei2 baak3 maan6
